summary: Mobile (390x844) verification of /demo (DemoFlow). Confirmed both reported bugs are fixed: (1) WhatsAppFab is NOT rendered on any step (0-4) of the demo; (2) GuideBar text is now readable — step label 12px bold uppercase, instruction 16px semibold, and CTA button is 56px tall (h-14). Full multi-step flow works end-to-end using ONLY the sticky guide-next button: step0 start -> step1 select Roofing (desc autofilled 146 chars) -> guide-next triggers busy-sheet -> step2 Quote (AI generated) -> guide-next -> step3 Agreement -> guide-next signs -> step4 Invoice -> guide-next marks paid, demo-paid-block visible, guide bar correctly hidden after payment.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoFlow.js is 959 lines — consider splitting sub-components (LeadStep/DescribeStep/QuoteStep/AgreementStep/InvoiceStep/FinalCTA) into separate files for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DemoFlow.js /demo route is public, no login. Guide bar (demo-guide-bar) is the primary progression control; whatsapp-fab is intentionally NOT rendered on this route (only exists in DemoFlujo.jsx /demo-flujo route).
rca of the issue: Prior mobile occlusion of demo advance buttons by WhatsAppFab was resolved by removing the FAB import/render from DemoFlow.js (still used only in DemoFlujo.jsx). Guide bar font sizes upgraded to text-base + h-14 button, confirmed via computed style (16px instr, 56px button).
